notes.title: Update 0.8
notes.notes:
[p]Excidio 0.8 Change Log[/p][h2]Arcade Mode Revamp![/h2][p]Arcade mode has been completely revamped! It is now much more inspired by Vampire Survivors. It has new effects, balance changes, changes to army AI, and buildings will now rebuild themselves to keep the carnage going![/p][h2]Map Improvements[/h2][p]All 3 maps have been completely remade! A complete overhaul, featuring new props, skybox, and textures.[/p][h2]Added skins for both Golem and Raijin![/h2][p]Both Golem and Raijin now have a skin each, these skins can be applied to enemy AI as well.[/p][h2]Combat and Control improvements![/h2][p]Changed Raijin's Ultimate Attack. Added a health bar to enemies, the hurt animation can now be triggered more often, for better feedback. Hold to sprint has been replaced with a Toggle sprint.[/p][h2]Visual improvements[/h2][p]Atmosphere effects can be triggered after destroying a certain amount of buildings. As well as lighting improvements, and some improved assets.[/p][h2]Stability Improvements[/h2][p]Added 30fps and 120fps options. Made many improvements for performance. Including better building models, reducing the amount of people, reducing explosion/smoke effects. Resulting in better performance and more gameplay clarity.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: RoadMap
notes.notes:
Hello, Excidio fans! We have recently come up with the exact scope and future of the project. Due to not being able to secure any funding we have decided to drastically reduce the scope. We have created a roadmap for the future of Excidio. 

Update 1
Enemy spawning system rework.
Playable Alpha Golem.
Alpha Golem boss.
Full controller support.

Update 2
Progression system: Each kaiju will have its own levelling system that unlocks skins and codex entries.

Update 3
Raijin boss and as a playable kaiju.

Update 4
Tokyo map. Possible name: Tokaijuo.

Update 5
New York Map. Possible name: New Kaijork.

Each update will also include bug fixes, quality-of-life stuff, new achievements and extra skins. After the progression system update the max rank will also be increased in every update. After and between these updates we will also include bug fixes. After all this content is complete and we feel the game is stable enough. We will then focus on launching the game on Xbox. If the game does well on Xbox we might look into adding split-screen multiplayer and porting to other consoles. 

Thank you all so much for joining us on this journey!

This is latest update for Excidio The Kaiju game. Purpose of this update is to test new mechanics and gameplay elements before launch of multiplayer. The reason it took so long for the update is I basically remade whole game with better code and to make it work in multiplayer. 

[b]New things in this update:[/b]

- New Energy/Stamina system 
- New AI
- New Visual effects
- New Overcharge ability for Excidio
- New interaction between objects 
- Destruction and optimization changes
- New camera position 
- New slow motion camera that you can change time speed with for cooler shots
- Dynamic fog that builds up as things are destroyed
- New throwable items

After I hear feedback on Energy/Stamina system I will improve it further with changes to damage,movement speed and things like that. Also If how fog works now is not liked I can remove it and put it back as it was before.

notes.title: Naval Update Incoming!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Naval Update incoming![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40510941/290dd7c305d30bcd94bda57ef567ae90de430b85.png[/img]
Hello everyone I would like to share with you some new things for new update! 

[h2][b]Ships[/b] [/h2]

First thing that is coming are ships! Ships will sail trough water and you will be able to sink them. Plan is to have few ship models including cargo ships, smaller civilan ships and military ships. 

[h2][b]Two new graphic options[/b][/h2]

With new update there will be also added two new graphical options 

One  will be [b]Advanced Destruction[/b] and Another will be Debris particles. First one will enable advanced destruction where structural integrity will be better and also will make it so destruction interacts with the world. One building falling on another will destroy that one and so on. 

Debris particles will make it so that debris from the destroyed buildings will create particle effects when they hit ground or water. Both of these make impact on fps but give a lot to a look and feel. It is optimal and if it proves that most users can't use it I will remove it. I optimized it as much as I could

There were some changes to lighting and night mode. Game models will have more depth now. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40510941/ba84448bfb3c4c25caeaec5905469c67f798af08.png[/img]

notes.title: Kaiju Ragdoll
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40510941/59497f4ec245db628d8a7692d4797d899423a318.png[/img][b]New combat[/b]

I have added Ragdoll physics to melee combat between Kaijus. Small Kaijus will be launched when hit by Excidio while bigger will resist some hits and sometimes be launched. Large Kaijus can also lunch Excidio. I think this brings a lot of fun to the game. Seeing monsters go through buildings or hitting something only for it to explode was a lot of fun for me while working on it. If you have half as much fun as I had I will be happy. I will continue to improve Ragdoll physics.

[b]Sandbox level changes[/b]

You can spawn enemies with num keys 1, 2,3,4 in sandbox level. Army will no longer spawn on it’s own. This may be only for this update or I can leave it like this depending on your feedback. Also City from Level 2 will be available as Sandbox level too. Hope is that this will provide you enough fun till I rework and create more story levels. 

Level 1 Rework.
I have redone level 1. It is now longer and provides players with more objectives. This is how I will rework the rest of the levels too and the patent I will use to create new levels. 

[b]New Enemies [/b]

I have created new Stone Golem enemies. Stone Golems are guardians placed on an island to keep Excido from ever escaping  And you can expect many more enemies to come. Some will be more interesting some will be less but all should be fun to fight.

[b]General changes:[/b]

Optimization
Excidio can attack while walking now
New attack SFX and VFX
New footstep SFX
